content: {"summary":"On 2025-02-15 payments‑api fell back to static rules and fraud‑scorer‑01 memory kept rising without a restart. Evidence shows payments‑api warnings about missing fraud scores and a known link between slow redis‑features reads and fraud‑scorer memory growth, which previously required restarts. The likely cause is latency spikes in redis‑features causing slow reads, inflating fraud‑scorer cache and forcing static‑rule fallback.","likely_cause":"Latency spikes in redis‑features causing slow reads, which inflate fraud‑scorer‑01 memory and make payments‑api fall back to static rules","confidence":"medium","claims":[{"text":"payments‑api is degraded and logs warnings that fraud scores are not returned, triggering static rules","evidence_ids":["status:payments-api","log:427"],"quote":"fraud score not returned in time, static rules applied"},{"text":"Fraud‑scorer memory grows when reads from redis‑features are slow","evidence_ids":["INC-0080#2","RB-006#2"],"quote":"cache inside each worker grows whenever reads from redis‑features are slow"},{"text":"Previous incident showed fraud‑scorer hitting near‑limit memory during redis‑features latency spikes and required a restart","evidence_ids":["INC-0080#2"],"quote":"fraud‑scorer‑02 stood at about 2,860 MiB of its 3,072 MiB limit"},{"text":"Runbook notes that fraud‑scorer issues are mostly seen during redis‑features latency spikes","evidence_ids":["RB-006#2"],"quote":"mostly when redis‑features latency spikes"}],"next_checks":["Check redis‑features latency metrics for 2025‑02‑15 around the warning times","Inspect fraud‑scorer‑01 memory (RSS) usage and GC logs for the same period","Review payments‑api logs for additional PAYAPI‑W0310 entries","Verify if any restarts of fraud‑scorer‑01 occurred after the memory rise","Consult RB‑006 for mitigation steps (e.g., restart after store stabilises)"]}
